component.name: Acorn File Forge
component.summary: Open and maintain Acorn media images

description.p: Acorn File Forge browses, edits, validates and converts Acorn BBC, Electron, Archimedes and RISC OS disk, tape, ROM and hard-drive images.
The Linux application uses the same filesystem and editor implementation as the web edition, with a GTK file chooser, desktop file associations and private XDG working state.
